verdict.reason: Host/project UI separation is well built for JURNL (scoped CSS, lazy registry, tests). But the data firewall is not enforced: RLS is service_role-only (no per-project/member policies) and two tables are open to anon. ~20 API endpoints take a project id from the caller with no auth. Client roles are request-spoofable, and all projects share one public storage bucket. Project data and canon can be read or changed across projects by an unauthenticated caller.
